text: dsh-chat-zone-std 是面向 DSH Web 和 TUI 的 dsh-std Community v0.15 插件，通过主机 Facet 注册命令与工具，并提供可选的浏览器设置区。它可以按本地日期创建连续编号的 chatN 文件夹，也能按日期倒序列出现有对话文件夹；创建仅准备目录，不会打开 DSH 会话。适合希望把每日对话目录整理到统一位置的 DSH 用户。运行需要 Node.js 20 或更新版本以及 @dsh-std/adapter-dsh；目录默认位于用户主目录下的 dsh_CHAT，可通过 DSH_CHAT_ZONE_HOME 指定主目录。

dsh-chat-zone-std adds daily chat-folder commands and tools to DSH Web/TUI, plus an optional settings panel. It creates the next chatN folder and lists folders by date. It requires the dsh-std DSH adapter and Node.js 20+. DSH_CHAT_ZONE_HOME can override the home directory.
想按日期自动新建一个连续编号的 DSH 对话文件夹。
能不能按日期整理并查看已有的 chatN 对话目录？
I want commands and tools for creating and listing daily DSH chat folders.
dsh-chat-zone-std 的功能「新建每日对话目录」：执行 chat-new 命令或调用 chat-zone-new 工具后，会在本地日期目录下创建下一个 chatN 文件夹并返回路径；它只创建文件夹，不会启动会话。
dsh-chat-zone-std 的功能「列出历史对话目录」：执行 chat-list 命令或调用 chat-zone-list 工具，可按日期倒序查看 dsh_CHAT 下符合日期和 chatN 格式的目录。

dsh-chat-zone-std README · dsh-chat-zone-std：[中文](README.zh.md) · English

**Compatible with dsh-std Community v0.15.**

A **dsh-std rewrite** of [dsh-chat-zone](https://github.com/lasdrder0705/dsh-chat-zone). Separate repository: the original Cordis sidebar plugin is not replaced. This package declares a static `dsh-plugin.json` and a `lifecycle.dsh/v1alpha1 FacetModule`.

dsh-chat-zone-std README · Compatibility：| | |
|---|---|
| Standard | [dsh-std](https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-std) Community v0.15 |
| `$schema` | `urn:dsh-std:community-draft:dsh-plugin:0.15` |
| Component id | `io.github.lasdrder0705.dsh-chat-zone-std` |
| Host entry | `lib/host.js` |
| Contributions | Commands `chat-new` / `chat-list`; Tools `chat-zone-new` / `chat-zone-list`; optional SettingsSection |
| DSH host | [`@dsh-std/adapter-dsh`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@dsh-std/adapter-dsh) |
dsh-chat-zone-std README · Compatibility：The host facet does not import `@deepseek-ai/*`. Product mapping stays in the adapter.

dsh-chat-zone-std README · Behavior：Creates:

```text
~/dsh_CHAT/<local yyyy-mm-dd>/chatN
```

Same numbering as the original: max `chatN + 1` for that day, no reuse of deleted numbers, up to 8 retries on collisions. This package **only creates folders**. Open the path as a DSH workspace afterwards.

dsh-chat-zone-std README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-std/adapter-dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lasdrder0705/dsh-chat-zone-std
```

Restart `dsh web`. Override the home directory with `DSH_CHAT_ZONE_HOME` (tests).
